applications.name: Turtling
applications.description: If the Attacker hasn't landed a hit in 6 seconds the Defender gains an indefinite Armor Up Buff, increasing their Armor Rating by [16982bff]30%[-], with a max of 3 stacks. Landing a hit resets the timer.
applications.rawDescription: If the Attacker hasn't landed a hit in {2} seconds the Defender gains an indefinite Armor Up Buff, increasing their Armor Rating by [16982bff]{1}%[-], with a max of 3 stacks. Landing a hit resets the timer.

applications.name: Chitinous Thorns
applications.description: Each time the Attacker makes contact with the Defender, the Attacker is inflicted with a Bleed Debuff for each Armor Up Buff on the Defender. Each Bleed deals [16982bff]50%[-] of the Defender's Attack in Direct Damage over [16982bff]5[-] second(s).
applications.rawDescription: Each time the Attacker makes contact with the Defender, the Attacker is inflicted with a Bleed Debuff for each Armor Up Buff on the Defender. Each Bleed deals [16982bff]{1}%[-] of the Defender's Attack in Direct Damage over [16982bff]5[-] second(s).

applications.name: Cosmic Fracture
applications.description: Cosmic Attacker's Light Attacks have a 50% chance to Armor Break the Defender, reducing their Armor Rating by 40% for 7 second(s). If the Light Hit was Critical, the chance is 100% instead.
applications.rawDescription: Cosmic Attacker's Light Attacks have a {2}% chance to Armor Break the Defender, reducing their Armor Rating by {1}% for 7 second(s). If the Light Hit was Critical, the chance is {0}% instead.

applications.name: Cutting Wires
applications.description: Whenever a Robotic Attacker would gain a Bleed Debuff, they instead gain a Shock Debuff dealing [16982bff]50%[-] of the Defender's Attack Rating as Direct Damage over 5 seconds.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever a Robotic Attacker would gain a Bleed Debuff, they instead gain a Shock Debuff dealing [16982bff]{1}%[-] of the Defender's Attack Rating as Direct Damage over {2} seconds.
